svg.title: Swapping in objects that slowly grow
svg.desc: A time-lapse of a 2000 MB address space with the fixed allocator, one row per load. The objects start at about 680 MB, vary by up to 20 MB and grow by half a megabyte per load. Load 74 fails with 1238 MB free.
svg.text: With the fix, and objects that slowly grow
411 MB of code, with no hole to go to
Load 74, after 12 hours, fails. The object is 734 MB.
1238 MB are free, and the biggest hole is 406 MB.
